title: OTel Pipeline Health
description: Real signal from the otel-collector's own internal telemetry (Prometheus job otel-collector-internal, port 8888) plus live trace search against Tempo. server.ts/lib/otelInitializer.ts exports traces via OTLP on every request — confirmed flowing end-to-end historically. As of .agents/handoffs/onda-4/0c9eff7 (Agente 04), lib/otelInitializer.ts also registers a real metricReader (PeriodicExportingMetricReader/OTLPMetricExporter) and logRecordProcessor (BatchLogRecordProcessor/OTLPLogExporter) pointed at the same collector endpoint, and infrastructure/observability/otel-collector.yml already has receivers+pipelines wired for metrics (-> prometheus exporter, port 9464) and logs (-> otlphttp/loki) — reviewed and confirmed by Agente 10 in .agents/handoffs/onda-4/04-para-10-dashboard-metrics-logs-reais.md. That review could NOT bring up docker-compose.opensource.yml in this environment (Docker Hub/quay.io/GitHub image and binary pulls are blocked by egress policy — 403 on every registry tried, not a transient failure) to confirm data actually lands in Prometheus/Loki, so the 'App Metrics (OTLP)' and 'Application Logs' panels below are NOT yet marked as carrying live data — per AGENTS.md §14/§17 this is reported as an unresolved environment limitation, not a false 'active' claim.

panels.title: Spans received/sec (app -> collector, OTLP)
panels.description: rate(otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans_total[5m]) — increases on every real request handled by the app, since lib/otelInitializer.ts exports a span per request via OTLP to this collector.

panels.title: Spans exported to Tempo/sec vs. failures/sec
panels.description: rate(otelcol_exporter_sent_spans_total[5m]) and rate(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans_total[5m]) — a sustained non-zero failure rate means Tempo is unreachable or rejecting spans, which the app itself has no visibility into (fire-and-forget OTLP export).

panels.title: Exporter queue size (Tempo)
panels.description: otelcol_exporter_queue_size — a queue that keeps growing means the collector is falling behind Tempo; investigate before spans start getting dropped.

panels.title: Collector uptime
panels.description: otelcol_process_uptime_seconds — resets to (near) zero on every collector restart/crash.

panels.title: Collector target up
panels.description: up{job="otel-collector-internal"} — 1 means Prometheus successfully scraped the collector's self-metrics on the last interval, 0 means the collector is down or unreachable.

panels.title: Recent Traces (Tempo — real data once the app has served requests)
Last 20 traces
panels.description: TraceQL search against Tempo for every trace received via the OTLP pipeline above. Empty until the app has handled at least one request after this stack was started.

panels.title: App Metrics (OTLP) — instrumented in code, live data not yet confirmed in this environment
Custom app metrics forwarded via otel-collector's prometheus exporter (port 9464)
panels.description: lib/otelInitializer.ts now registers a real metricReader (PeriodicExportingMetricReader + OTLPMetricExporter, 10s interval) instead of a no-op MeterProvider, and otel-collector.yml's metrics pipeline (receivers: [otlp], exporters: [prometheus]) is already wired to receive it — see .agents/handoffs/onda-4/04-para-10-dashboard-metrics-logs-reais.md. This panel will surface real series automatically the first time the app runs against a real otel-collector with traffic flowing; it still shows no data here because this environment could not pull the otel-collector/Prometheus images (Docker Hub and quay.io both return 403 under this session's egress policy) to run docker-compose.opensource.yml and prove the metric actually lands in Prometheus. No fabricated number is shown per AGENTS.md §14.

panels.title: Application Logs (Loki) — instrumented in code, live data not yet confirmed in this environment
Logs forwarded via otel-collector's logs pipeline (OTLP -> Loki)
panels.description: src/lib/logger.ts now bridges pino output into the OTel Logs API, and lib/otelInitializer.ts registers a real logRecordProcessor (BatchLogRecordProcessor + OTLPLogExporter) that turns that bridge from a no-op into a live OTLP export; otel-collector.yml's logs pipeline (receivers: [otlp], exporters: [otlphttp/loki]) is already wired to receive it — see .agents/handoffs/onda-4/04-para-10-dashboard-metrics-logs-reais.md. This panel will surface real log lines automatically once the app runs against a real otel-collector/Loki. It still shows no data here because this environment could not pull the otel-collector/Loki images (Docker Hub and quay.io both return 403 under this session's egress policy) to run docker-compose.opensource.yml and confirm log records actually land in Loki. No fabricated log line is shown per AGENTS.md §14.
